import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Separate features and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train_df[feature_cols].values
y = train_df["Cover_Type"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Encode target for LightGBM (0-indexed)
le = LabelEncoder()
y_encoded = le.fit_transform(y)

# Stratified train/validation split (using subset for faster validation)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y_encoded, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_encoded
)

# LightGBM parameters optimized for accuracy and speed
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(np.unique(y_encoded)),
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Create datasets
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

# Train model
lgb_model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = lgb_model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=lgb_model.best_iteration)
val_pred_classes = np.argmax(y_val_pred, axis=1)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred_classes)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Train final model on full data
lgb_train_full = lgb.Dataset(X, y_encoded)
lgb_model_full = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    lgb_train_full,
    num_boost_round=lgb_model.best_iteration,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train_full],
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Predict on test set
test_pred = lgb_model_full.predict(X_test, num_iteration=lgb_model_full.best_iteration)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1)

# Inverse transform to original labels
test_pred_labels = le.inverse_transform(test_pred_classes)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred_labels.astype(int)}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
